config.betaLoadSimulation: Beta: Show the load simulation in the status bar — estimated tokens each tool (Kiro / Copilot) would load for the active file.
config.betaSpecs: Beta: Show the Specs section (.kiro/specs) in the SkillMap view.
config.canonicalRoots: Directories treated as the canonical source when the same skill exists in several locations (in priority order). Copies elsewhere are grouped as replicas and only drift-checked.
config.copyTreeStyle: Style of the tree text copied by the Copy Tree commands: Unicode box-drawing characters, or plain ASCII for environments that cannot display them.
config.descriptionMaxLength: R2: Maximum length of the frontmatter description (0 disables the rule).
config.maxReferenceDepth: R6: Maximum reference depth counted inside skill-owned files before a warning is shown (0 disables the rule). Counting stops at files outside the skill, such as steering files.
config.orphanFiles: R9: Severity for files that exist inside a skill directory but are not referenced from anywhere.
config.skillBodyMaxLines: R4: Maximum lines allowed in a SKILL.md body before a warning is shown (0 disables the rule).
config.skillBodyMaxTokens: R5: Maximum estimated tokens allowed in SKILL.md before a warning is shown (0 disables the rule).
config.skillTotalTokenBudget: R10: Budget for the whole skill's total estimated tokens, excluding duplicates (0 disables the rule).
config.skillsRoots: Additional directories (relative to the workspace root) to scan for SKILL.md files, beyond automatic discovery.
config.steeringAlwaysTokenBudget: S3: Budget for the total estimated tokens of always-loaded steering files (0 disables the rule).
skillmap.description: Visualize Agent Skills, Kiro Steering/Specs and Copilot instructions as a reference-relationship tree in the Explorer, with estimated token costs and best-practice warnings that teach through Tips. 100% local, no tracking.
view.name: SkillMap
